description: JMAP method-call batch with automatic auth. Exactly one of: `ops` (JSON string: methodCalls array or full envelope) or `ops_file` (preset path; relative to credential directory). `$VAR` substitution and optional file `attachments`: see `help` topics presets and jmap_cheatsheet.

attachments.description: Local files POSTed to session uploadUrl before ops; see help topic presets.

content_type.description: MIME type for upload `Content-Type` (default: guessed from filename).

filename.description: Attachment filename in the message (default: basename of path).

path.description: Readable file path on the MCP host (absolute or relative to cwd).

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

dry_run.description: Resolve variables/envelope and return the request body without sending it.

ops.description: Inline JSON. Mutually exclusive with ops_file.

ops_file.description: Preset path. Mutually exclusive with ops.

using.description: Capability URNs merged when `ops` has no `using` (ignored if ops sets `using`).

vars.description: String map for `$PLACEHOLDER` values (keys without `$`). Overrides session keys and `ATTACHMENT_*` when attachments are set.

name: jmap_request
title: Send a JMAP request
